name: raynerslanefc-website
description: Rayners Lane FC — static site + Netlify functions. No build step; this file only provides function dependencies (web-push for match-alert notifications).

scripts._comment: Tests use node:test, built into Node 20+ (the version netlify.toml pins). No dependencies, no runner to install — the same no-build-step discipline as the rest of the repo. Netlify never invokes these.
scripts.test:db: psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d rlfc_mdops_test -f supabase/migrations/20260730000000_matchday_ops.sql && psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d rlfc_mdops_test -f supabase/tests/matchday_ops_invariants.sql
